  • Method Details

    • roots

      public Configuration.Builder roots(String first, String... more)
      Sets the root directories. A Unix-style file system has the one root /; a Windows-style one has drives, such as C:\, and UNC shares, such as \\server\share\.
      Parameters:
      first - the first root
      more - the other roots
      Returns:
      this builder
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if a root is not the root of an absolute path of the style, is given twice, or a Unix-style file system is given another root than /

    • workingDirectory

      public Configuration.Builder workingDirectory(String path)
      Sets the working directory, which relative paths are resolved against. It is created with the file system, with the directories it is in.
      Parameters:
      path - the absolute path of the directory, on one of the roots
      Returns:
      this builder

    • unicodeNormalization

      public Configuration.Builder unicodeNormalization(@Nullable Normalizer.Form form)
      Sets the Unicode normalization names are matched under: with any form, a name written with composed or decomposed characters names the same file. Names are still shown as they were created.
      Parameters:

      Returns:
      this builder

    • attributeViews

      public Configuration.Builder attributeViews(String... views)
      Sets the supported attribute views: any of basic, owner, posix, unix, dos, acl and user. The file system also supports basic and the views these extend, as posix extends owner.
      Parameters:
      views - the names of the views
      Returns:
      this builder
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if a view is unknown

    • defaultAttribute

      public Configuration.Builder defaultAttribute(String attribute, Object value)
      Sets an attribute new files get unless they are given it: owner:owner (a user name), posix:group (a group name), posix:permissions (a Set<PosixFilePermission> or a string such as rw-r--r--), dos:readonly, dos:hidden, dos:system or dos:archive (a Boolean), or acl:acl (a List<AclEntry>). Its view must be supported when the configuration is built.
      Parameters:
      attribute - the attribute, as view:name
      value - the value
      Returns:
      this builder
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the attribute is not one of these, or the value has the wrong type

    • currentUser

      public Configuration.Builder currentUser(String user, String... groups)
      Enforces permissions, checking them against a user and their groups. The files the user creates belong to them and to their first group, unless owner:owner and posix:group have defaults.
      Parameters:
      user - the user name
      groups - the groups of the user
      Returns:
      this builder

    • noCurrentUser

      public Configuration.Builder noCurrentUser()
      Stops enforcing permissions. They are still stored.
      Returns:
      this builder
